aiopsSqlJson.keyPatterns.markdownDescription: Case-sensitive glob patterns used to identify SQL properties. `*` matches any number of characters, `?` matches one character, and multiple patterns are combined with OR semantics.

aiopsSqlJson.multilineStrings.allowAll.markdownDescription: Whether physical line breaks are allowed in every JSON string. When disabled, only direct string values whose property names match `aiopsSqlJson.keyPatterns` may span physical lines.

aiopsSqlJson.dialect.markdownDescription: The SQL dialect used for both embedded SQL and regular `.sql` files.

aiopsSqlJson.plainSql.enabled.markdownDescription: Whether this extension provides completion, syntax validation, and semantic highlighting for regular `.sql` files.

aiopsSqlJson.schemaValidation.enabled.markdownDescription: Whether to validate SQL table, column, and function references against the DDL files configured by `aiopsSqlJson.schemaFiles`. This is an offline static check and does not connect to a database.

aiopsSqlJson.schemaValidation.completion.markdownDescription: When Schema validation is enabled, use the indexed DDL for Schema-aware completion but suppress all Schema-derived query and DDL diagnostics. Regular SQL, JSON, and platform diagnostics remain enabled.

aiopsSqlJson.schemaFiles.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for `.sql` files containing explicit `CREATE TABLE` and inferable `CREATE VIEW` DDL. Supports stable VS Code path variables such as `${workspaceFolder}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${userHome}`, and `${env:NAME}`.

aiopsSqlJson.udfs.markdownDescription: User-defined SQL function names to include in completion and accept during schema validation. Signatures and argument types are not checked.

aiopsSqlJson.placeholderPatterns.markdownDescription: Regular expression sources for template placeholders to mask with equal-length text before parsing. Expressions run in global Unicode mode; SQL validation is strict by default.

aiopsSqlJson.placeholders.allowEverywher.markdownDescription: Whether placeholder patterns may appear in strings, unquoted property keys, and bare JSON tokens throughout `.sql.json` files. When disabled, placeholders are masked only while validating recognized SQL strings and regular `.sql` files.

aiopsSqlJson.format.maxLineWidth.markdownDescription: Maximum visual line width for formatted SQL. In SQL JSON documents the embedded SQL base indentation and closing JSON punctuation count toward the limit. A single indivisible token may exceed it.

aiopsSqlJson.format.maxInlineExpressionD.markdownDescription: Maximum number of nested non-leaf SQL AST expressions that may remain on one line. Arithmetic operator chains and grouping parentheses are excluded; arithmetic wrapping is used only as a max-line-width fallback.

aiopsSqlJson.format.maxInlineItems.markdownDescription: Maximum number of high-level or structural list items, CASE branches, or logical leaf predicates that may remain inline in `compact` layout mode. Exceeding the limit expands that semantic group without chunking items across lines. Local function arguments, `IN` lists, arrays, and row constructors are not item-limited.

enumDescriptions: Keep complete clauses and high-level structures inline when they fit, then break them at semantic boundaries.
Always expand statement-level lists, CASE branches, and logical predicates.
aiopsSqlJson.format.layoutMode.markdownDescription: Layout strategy for breakable SQL structures. `compact` keeps complete clauses and expressions inline when possible; `expanded` always places high-level and structural list items, CASE branches, and logical predicates on separate lines. Local function arguments and parentheses remain width/depth-aware in both modes.

aiopsSqlJson.format.structuralParenthesi.markdownDescription: Controls only the opening-parenthesis position for CTEs, subqueries, `CREATE TABLE` schemas, and `INSERT` target column lists. `sameLine` keeps the opening parenthesis attached to its syntactic introducer even when the contents expand; `newLine` places it on a new line at the introducer's indentation. Content layout is decided independently.

aiopsSqlJson.format.sqlJson.baseIndent.markdownDescription: Base indentation of embedded SQL. A number is measured in `editor.tabSize` levels; `auto` indents one level deeper than the containing JSON property.

aiopsSqlJson.format.keywordCase.markdownDescription: Casing of unquoted SQL keywords during formatting.

aiopsSqlJson.format.functionCase.markdownDescription: Casing of unquoted SQL function names during formatting.

aiopsSqlJson.format.dataTypeCase.markdownDescription: Casing of unquoted SQL data type names during formatting.

aiopsSqlJson.format.commaPosition.markdownDescription: Comma placement in expanded SQL lists.

aiopsSqlJson.format.logicalOperatorPosit.markdownDescription: Placement of AND, OR, and XOR when a logical expression is split across lines.

aiopsSqlJson.format.blankLinesBetweenSta.markdownDescription: Number of blank lines between formatted SQL statements.
